notes.title: Bug report for ver03.03.01
notes.content:
There was a problem in ver03.03.01.

[b]Details of the bug:[/b]
- Chords can no longer be registered in the player.
- There is a possibility that some kind of problem is hidden in the way the player manages chords.

We are currently investigating the cause, but it may take some time to fix it, so we will downgrade to ver03.02.01.
As a result, the loop playback added in ver03.03.01 will not be possible.

We will notify you of the update as soon as the problem is resolved.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but thank you for your understanding.

[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver03.03.01
notes.content:
[b]Postscript: December 22, 2022[/b]
There was a problem with ver03.03.01, so I downgraded to ver03.02.01.
Therefore, the following update contents are not reflected.

As soon as the problem is resolved, we will contact you again for an update.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Player loop playback is now possible.
This makes it possible to check the chord progression while looping playback.
Loop playback is possible by activating the loop button.
(For details on how to operate, please check the video "How to operate" on the Steam store page.)

[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver03.02.01
notes.content:
Now supports 13 languages.
To change the language, select [Edit] from the menu and select [Language].

[b]Supported languages[/b]
[list]
[*] Deutsch
[*] English
[*] Español
[*] Français
[*] Italiano
[*] 日本語
[*] 한국어
[*] Polski
[*] Português
[*] Русский
[*] Türkçe
[*] 简体中文
[*] 繁體中文
[/list]
Chord notation is C, D, E, F, G, A, B notation.

[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver03.01.01
notes.content:
Chord inversion is now possible.
For example, one chord [Dm] can be played by switching the notes like [D3 - F3 - A3], [F3 - A3 - D4], [A3 - D4 - F4].
In popular music, they are written as [Dm/F] and [Dm/A].
(Only normal chords are supported. Guitar chords are not supported.)

[b]Effect when used[/b]
[list]
[*] It is possible to suppress the range of pitch movement during chord progression, making it easier to hear the chord progression.
[*] You can change the impression of the sound of the chord by changing the lowest note even with the same chord.
[/list]
[b]Method of operation[/b]
You can change the inversion of the chord by pressing [Z] + [LMB] or [Alt] + [LMB] on the chord placed on the timeline.
(The operation method is also displayed at the bottom of the tool screen.)

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Some key assignments have been changed. If you have changed the key to operate, please check [Key Bindings] in the menu.
[*] Files saved in the latest version can no longer be opened in lower versions.
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver02.03.01
notes.content:
Key bindings is now possible.
To change the key, select [Edit] from the menu and then select [Key Bindings].

Note:
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver02.02.01
notes.content:
You can now change the screen size.
You can change the screen size of OZ Chord Player by changing the screen resolution.

To change the screen resolution, select [Edit] from the menu and then select [Screen Resolution]. 
[list]
[*]The minimum resolution that can be set is 848 * 600.
[*] There is no limit to the maximum resolution that can be set.
[*] The maximum resolution that can be set is limited so that it does not exceed the resolution of the monitor you are using.
[*]The default screen resolution is 1130 * 800.
[*] If the resolution is smaller than the default setting, the image will be slightly degraded.
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)

notes.title: Update ver02.01.01
notes.content:
Added support for exporting MIDI files.
The chords placed side by side on the timeline can be exported as a MIDI file.

To export a MIDI file, select the File menu and then select Export MIDI File from the list.
(Volume settings and arpeggios are not reflected.)

[b]Note:[/b]
If you want to use an earlier version, open the game properties on Steam, select BETAS, and select the previous version.
(You do not need to enter the access code.)
